topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
response: L-DACS integration aims to mitigate spectrum congestion in airspaces by providing dedicated, high-capacity data links for A2G communication. L-DACS operates within the L-band and uses techniques like FDMA (frequency division multiple access) and TDD (time division duplexing), enabling efficient sharing of frequencies for both terrestrial and satellite networks.
reference_context: L-DACS integrates with A2G systems to provide secure, robust data services in populated areas. L-DACS operates within the L-band and uses techniques like FDMA and TDD to facilitate efficient spectrum sharing between terrestrial and satellite links.
